# Tanit XR

> A volunteer nonprofit preserving Tunisia's endangered cultural heritage in 3D, AR and VR,
> and publishing it free for anyone to use. Volunteers in Tunisia, the United States, Europe
> and Nigeria scan sites and objects with phones and cameras, turn them into 3D models, research
> their history, and build immersive experiences. Fiscally sponsored by Florida Community
> Innovation, a US 501(c)(3). Founded and led by Ines Said.

Everything on this site is free to read, quote and link. Please credit Tanit XR and link back
to https://tanitxr.org/. Last updated 2026-09-25.

## What people usually want

- [Explore in 3D](https://tanitxr.org/explore/): the collection in the browser, one object at a time, no app or headset needed. Works in VR headsets too.
- [Art, XR and Impact Opportunities](https://tanitxr.org/opportunities/): a free curated board of grants, residencies, fellowships, open calls and events for artists, XR creators, educators, students and changemakers. Also sent free by email.
- [The archive](https://tanitxr.org/archive/): every 3D scan, each with its own page, history and downloadable or viewable model.
- [Volunteer](https://tanitxr.org/volunteer/): how to join, no archaeology or 3D background needed.
- [Partner with us](https://tanitxr.org/partners/): for companies and foundations.
- [Contact](https://tanitxr.org/contact/): info@tanitxr.org

## Pages

- [Home](https://tanitxr.org/): Tanit XR is a volunteer nonprofit preserving Tunisia's endangered heritage in 3D. Explore Carthage, Dougga and the medinas of Tunis as free 3D models you can turn in your browser, in AR and in VR.
- [About](https://tanitxr.org/about/): Why Tanit XR exists, who builds it, and how a volunteer network in Tunisia, the United States, Europe and Nigeria documents endangered heritage in 3D and gives it away free.
- [Archive](https://tanitxr.org/archive/): Every 3D scan Tanit XR volunteers have made of Tunisian heritage: mosaics, statues, stelae, columns and doors from Carthage, Dougga, El Jem and the medinas. Free to view, study and explore in 3D.

- [Coming Soon](https://tanitxr.org/coming-soon/): This part of Tanit XR is still being built. In the meantime, explore the free 3D archive of Tunisian heritage or join the volunteer network.
- [Community](https://tanitxr.org/community/): Tanit XR is a weekly community of volunteers in Tunisia, the US, Europe and Nigeria, scanning, learning history, mentoring and building a free 3D archive.
- [Contact](https://tanitxr.org/contact/): Reach Tanit XR: write to info@tanitxr.org about volunteering, partnerships, press, speaking, or using our free 3D models of Tunisian heritage in teaching and research.
- [Create Your Profile](https://tanitxr.org/create-profile/): Already volunteering with Tanit XR? Send your profile and, once the team approves it, your page appears under Our People with every scan, model and article credited to you.
- [El Jem Conference](https://tanitxr.org/el-jem-conference/): Our El Jem conference paper, in English, French and Tunisian Arabic: how digital documentation, XR and citizen science support community-led heritage preservation in Tunisia and beyond.
- [Explore in 3D](https://tanitxr.org/explore/): Tunisia's heritage in your hands: 69 objects scanned and modelled by volunteers. Turn them, meet Nura, save and share them, in your browser or a headset.
- [Galleries](https://tanitxr.org/galleries/): Five halls of Tunisian heritage scanned by Tanit XR volunteers. Turn every object in 3D, from Punic stelae at Carthage to Ottoman tilework in Kairouan.
- [ImmerseGT 2026](https://tanitxr.org/immersegt-2026/): Tanit XR sponsored a heritage track and a prize at ImmerseGT, the XR hackathon at Georgia Tech, with a workshop on citizen science and XR by Dr. Caroline Nickerson.
- [Virtual Museum](https://tanitxr.org/museum/): The first community-led virtual museum of Tunisian heritage, real scans placed in rooms built by volunteers in Unity. Walkthroughs, progress and how to help.
- [News and stories](https://tanitxr.org/news/): Stories written by Tanit XR volunteers about Carthage and Tunisian heritage, and announcements about where the project will be next.
- [A 2,000-Year-Old Ghost Town on Cape Bon](https://tanitxr.org/news/a-2-000-year-old-ghost-town-on-cape-bon/): A scruffy brown donkey lowered its eyelids as a merchant filled its wooden cart with stacked bins of corn and melons. We saw several more like it as w

- [Tanit XR at CityCamp Gainesville Hack Day](https://tanitxr.org/news/tanit-xr-at-citycamp-gainesville-hack-day/): Tanit XR is taking part in CityCamp Gainesville Hack Day on Sunday, September 20, 2026, at the Reitz Union, University of Florida, an official MLH Hac
- [Art, XR & Impact Opportunities](https://tanitxr.org/opportunities/): A free curated board of grants, residencies, fellowships, open calls and events for artists, XR creators, educators, students and changemakers. Updated regularly by Tanit XR, and sent free by email.
- [Partner with us](https://tanitxr.org/partners/): For companies and foundations: how to partner with Tanit XR, from teaching your team to scan to adopting a site in the virtual museum.
- [Press & Recognition](https://tanitxr.org/press/): Awards, talks, podcasts, articles and papers about Tanit XR, including the Auggie Awards 2026 finalist nomination and the Voices of VR interview.
- [Privacy Policy](https://tanitxr.org/privacy/): What tanitxr.org collects, which is almost nothing: no cookies, no advertising, no visitor identification, and the third parties that host the site, the forms and the 3D models.
- [Tanit XR Scanning Guide](https://tanitxr.org/scanning-guide/): How Tanit XR volunteers capture heritage in 3D with a phone: the ethics we work by, what to scan and what to leave alone, and Scaniverse step by step from setup to export.
- [Services](https://tanitxr.org/services/): Work with the Tanit XR team: workshops and training, talks and consulting, sharing opportunities and hackathon tracks, free for grassroots groups, low rates for institutions. Our volunteers’ work is never for sale.
- [Splats With Phones](https://tanitxr.org/splats-with-phones/): A free course on capturing places with a phone using Gaussian splatting and photogrammetry, taught through Tanit XR for volunteers documenting heritage.
- [Submit your model](https://tanitxr.org/submit-a-model/): Send Tanit XR a 3D scan: upload the file, paste a link to it, or give us a Sketchfab address, with what the object is and where it came from.
- [Support](https://tanitxr.org/support/): Support Tanit XR: donations are tax deductible through our fiscal sponsor, Florida Community Innovation, and pay for scanning trips, training and the free 3D archive. Nobody here is paid.
- [Our People](https://tanitxr.org/team/): The volunteers behind Tanit XR, in Tunisia, the United States, Europe and Nigeria: who they are and every scan, 3D model and article each of them has contributed.

- [TanitXR & the Unique Mappers](https://tanitxr.org/unique-mappers/): The Unique Mappers Network, over 500 citizen scientists in Nigeria, is replicating the Tanit XR model: documenting local heritage in 3D and publishing it free.
- [Volunteer](https://tanitxr.org/volunteer/): Volunteer with Tanit XR from anywhere: 3D scanning, model cleanup, XR development, history research, writing, translation and design. No archaeology or 3D background needed, all remote friendly.
